children: Definium Therapeutics announced positive Phase 3 Panorama topline results for DT120 ODT 100 µg, meeting the primary and all key secondary endpoints with a placebo‑adjusted HAM‑A improvement of 5.1 points at Week 12.
Panorama met primary and all key secondary endpoints; DT120 ODT 100 µg vs placebo showed LS mean HAM‑A change -9.8 vs -4.7 (placebo‑adjusted -5.1, p<0.0001).
Rapid, durable efficacy: significant separation as early as Day 2 and sustained through Week 12; standardized effect size d=0.64 at Week 12.
Favorable tolerability: generally well tolerated, no drug‑related serious adverse events or suicidality signal; most TEAEs mild/moderate and transient.
Dose response consistent with prior data: 50 µg arm showed smaller placebo‑adjusted effects (~29–50% lower than 100 µg).
Regulatory path: pre‑NDA meeting scheduled for 4Q 2026 and NDA filing anticipated in 1H 2027; company hosted an investor webcast.

title: Definium Therapeutics reports positive Phase 3 Panorama topline: DT120 ODT 100 µg shows -5.1 HAM-A benefit
